_doc: The greybox's Mountain Folk preset (ThuyVanPreset; plan phase 1, T5): a look made through the creator's own preset machinery (CharacterPeoples.preset_look: the first of `faces` this build has for the body type; failing those, the first preset of the first people whose id holds one of `people_like`), then weathered and dressed in today's garments nearest the Common Folk sheet's Mountain Folk (a crossed wrap tunic, wrapped trousers, a sash; bare feet). No new garment or texture. The player's saved look on disk is never written (PlayerAppearance.apply does not save).

Every garment is the first of its list this build dresses in (PlayerOutfit.usable); '-' leaves the slot bare. colors: zone index -> '#hex' (or a catalog preset name under 'preset', the zones given over it). The ring set's wrap tunic and wrapped trousers are re-dyed in undyed hemp, walnut brown and madder rust: no element colours.
people: English names only until the owner picks the Vietnamese (plan 9, Q4).
